div.head: VIII Atr 4.1
div.ab: gebete man ærest þæne griðbryce into ðære cyrcan, be þam þe seo dæd sy ⁊ be ðam þe ðære cyrcan mæð sy.
Bete man æfre ærest þone griðbryce into ðare circan be þam þe seo dæd sy ⁊ be þam þe þare circan mæð sy.
And in the first instance, amends for breach of its protection shall always be made to the church, in accordance with the nature of the offence and also in proportion to the status of the church.
Always first the church is to be compensated for the violation of sanctuary, in proportion to the deed and in proportion to the status of that church.
büsse er (immer D) zuerst an die [verletzte] Kirche den Bruch des Sonderfriedens, je nachdem die Missethat ist und je nachdem der Rang dieser Kirche ist.
let him (always, D) first pay compensation to the [violated] church for the breach of protection, according to what the deed is and according to the rank of that church.
